description: This Dart source file defines an AudioService class that manages audio playback and microphone monitoring in a Flutter app. It uses external packages like just_audio, audio_session, file_picker, and permission_handler to handle audio operations, permissions, and file selection. The class exposes methods to initialize audio sessions, load media files, control playback, and handle microphone permissions, encapsulating the app's audio routing logic.

classes.name: AudioEngineState
classes.description: An enum representing the current state of the audio engine, options include stopped, running, and error.

classes.name: AudioService
classes.description: A class that manages audio playback and microphone monitoring, providing methods to initialize sessions, load files, control playback, and respond to permission requests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the audio session and subscribes to player state changes.

methods.name: disposeService
methods.description: Disposes of audio resources, cancels subscriptions, and should be called when the service is no longer needed.

methods.name: _setState
methods.description: Private method to update the engine state and notify listeners.

methods.name: startMicrophoneMonitoring
methods.description: Requests microphone permission and sets the engine to the running state (without starting native capture).

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops current audio playback or microphone monitoring, sets state to stopped.

methods.name: pickAndLoadMediaFile
methods.description: Opens a file picker for user to select media, loads it into the player, and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback if a media file is loaded.

methods.name: togglePlayPause
methods.description: Switches between playing and pausing the media.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Applies user audio settings such as amplification to the media player volume.
